name: Komodo Chinese Restaurant
description: Chinese food in Windsor Park Plaza on Autumnwood Drive: chop suey, Cantonese chow mein, ginger beef, honey garlic and sweet & sour dishes, Szechuan and curry dishes, and family dinners. Prices are from the printed take-out menu and may have changed, so please call to confirm.
